mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.publisher_id, o.taker_id, o.pickup_code, o.express_company, o.pickup_location, o.deliver_location, o.expect_time, o.remark, o.reward_amount, o.version, o.status, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.confirm_arrival_time, o.cancel_reason, o.pickup_photo, o.deliver_photo, o.transfer_status, o.transfer_reason, pu.username AS publisher_name, tu.username AS taker_name, tu.credit_score AS taker_credit_score FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user pu ON o.publisher_id = pu.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user tu ON o.taker_id = tu.user_id

SELECT o.order_id, o.publisher_id, o.taker_id, o.express_company, o.pickup_location, o.deliver_location, o.expect_time, o.remark, o.reward_amount, o.version, o.status, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.confirm_arrival_time, o.cancel_reason, o.transfer_status, o.transfer_reason, pu.username AS publisher_name, tu.username AS taker_name, tu.credit_score AS taker_credit_score FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user pu ON o.publisher_id = pu.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user tu ON o.taker_id = tu.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET taker_id = #{takerId}, status = '已接单', version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(), cancel_reason = NULL WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = '待接单' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE t_order SET taker_id = #{takerId}, transfer_status = NULL, transfer_reason = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND transfer_status = '待接力' AND taker_id = #{oldTakerId} AND version = #{version} AND status IN ('已接单', '取件中') AND expect_time > NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order o WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND (o.publisher_id = #{userId} OR o.taker_id = #{userId}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_evaluation e WHERE e.order_id = o.order_id AND e.evaluator_id = #{userId} )
